grouping: Translations share a SHA-256 hash of language-neutral generated facts and remain in one split.
limitations: Template families share scenario structures; distinct facts and split isolation do not establish independent real-world evaluation.
expectedOutput and expectedPrivacy are generated candidate labels, not human-approved truth or measured model outputs.
All review flags remain unreviewed; no weights are trained or model quality scores produced.
Cipher candidate labels require review against the chosen privacy policy: dummy, reserved and nonoperational fixture values may require Safe labels.
Long-tail cases require actual tokenizer coverage measurement; incomplete screening must remain unknown or partial.
